news.title: Drewry installed as inaugural Llorin-Roa professor
news.summary_en: Anne M. Drewry, MD, a nationally recognized leader in critical care medicine, has been installed as the inaugural Llorin-Roa Professor of Anesthesiology at WashU Medicine.

news.title: Learning from our ‘priors’
news.summary_en: Behavioral science researchers at WashU have gathered evidence on the benefits of using a Bayesian statistical framework for replicating research.
